Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 11 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Shalini - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Meera - 11 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
4. Zoya - 10 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Zoya stand near him.]

Rohan: "What lovely weather!"

[It starts to rain.]

Shalini (laughing): "Good job, Zoya!"

[A light drizzle begins.]

Zoya (happily): "Hmm, I see."

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Shalini: "Good job, Rohan!"

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Rohan: "Yes, of course."

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Rohan: "Yes, all right."

[Hailstones start falling.]

Rohan: "Oh wow!"

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Rohan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "Rohan, look over here."

[Rohan writes in his notebook.]

Rohan: "Oh wow!"

[Rohan opens the door and goes out.]

Rohan: "Mom, look at this."

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

Shalini: "Let's begin."

[Rohan makes tea for everyone.]

Rohan (excited): "What next?"

[Rohan chops onions for the curry.]

Rohan: "That was such a fun day!"
